description: This file defines Swagger API resource schemas for the Self Clients API in the Fineract project. It contains data transfer object classes representing various responses and their nested components for self client data, accounts, charges, and transactions.

classes.name: SelfClientsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes that define response schemas for various self client API responses. It is annotated for Swagger documentation.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsResponse
classes.description: Represents the response structure for retrieving a list of self clients, including total records and set of page items.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsPageItems
classes.description: Contains individual client data, such as id, account number, status, activity, activation date, fullname, display name, office info.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsStatus
classes.description: Represents the status type of a self client with id, code, description.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdResponse
classes.description: Detailed response for a specific self client, including personal info, timeline, account info, savings product details, and groups.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsTimeline
classes.description: Tracks submission and activation dates and reviewers for a client.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdAccountsResponse
classes.description: Aggregates loan and savings account details for the client, including status, type, currency, and account-specific info.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsLoanAccounts
classes.description: Details about individual loan accounts, including status, type, identifiers, and product info.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsLoanAccountsStatus
classes.description: Loan account status with multiple boolean flags indicating current state.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsLoanAccountsType
classes.description: Type of loan account (e.g., individual).

classes.name: GetSelfClientsSavingsAccounts
classes.description: Details of savings accounts linked to the client, including status and currency.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsSavingsAccountsCurrency
classes.description: Currency details for savings accounts.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsSavingsAccountsStatus
classes.description: Status of savings accounts.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdChargesResponse
classes.description: Response containing charges associated with the client, including page items and detailed charge info.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsChargesPageItems
classes.description: Represents individual charge item details, including timing, calculation type, amounts, and status flags.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsChargeTimeType
classes.description: Charge time type with code and description.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsChargeCalculationType
classes.description: Charge calculation type details.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdChargesChargeIdResponse
classes.description: Response for specific charge by charge ID with all relevant details.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdTransactionsResponse
classes.description: Contains transactions associated with the client, including nested transaction items.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdTransactionsPageItems
classes.description: Individual transaction details, including type, amount, date, and reversal status.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdTransactionsType
classes.description: Type of transaction with code and description.

classes.name: GetSelfClientsClientIdTransactionsTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Details of a specific transaction by transaction ID.
